11901|c5ceacbe.name: Andruk
11901|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

12196|7161de72.name: Innkeeper Kaylisk
12196|7161de72.text: If we are to make these new lands ours then we must have places to rest our battle weary bodies. Lay your axe by the fire and share the stories of your mighty battles.

12696|f1d5ba87.name: Senani Thunderheart
12696|f1d5ba87.text: Do you hear the call of the hunt, $c?  You must listen closely, but the call comes from deep within you.  It comes from deep within all of us.

12724|39b67c2e.name: Pixel
12724|39b67c2e.text: This forest can be confusing! Be careful out there.

12757|9b4e17a6.name: Karang Amakkar
12757|9b4e17a6.text: Greeting $c - welcome to the front lines in our conquest of Ashenvale!  If you are looking for something to do, then you've come to the right place.  I'm always looking for able-bodied individuals to help bring glory to the Horde!

3309|ae78a458.name: Karus
3309|ae78a458.text: Would you rather trust your goods with a goblin?

216-complete.name: Karang Amakkar
216-complete.text:
Well done $c, well done!  I will continue to send forces to thin out the furbolg, but I can at least count on a different path that will be free of Alliance entanglements.  The Horde conquest of Ashenvale is now in full swing!

You've earned your pay this day, hero.  I salute you!
216-complete.title: Between a Rock and a Thistlefur

24-accept.name: Unknown
24-accept.text: The once swift Shadumbra now lies still as you claim victory over it.  The head of the slain nightsaber is a fitting trophy for this fight of the Ashenvale Hunt.  Senani Thunderheart at Splintertree Post will want to see such a trophy to award you credit for this part of the Ashenvale Hunt.
24-accept.title: Shadumbra's Head

24-complete.name: Senani Thunderheart
24-complete.text:
A victory for $N in the Ashenvale Hunt!  Well done - the head of Shadumbra is a fitting trophy to claim for such an impressive fight, no doubt.

Shadumbra's savagery was well known throughout the post here.  Any trip to the west, especially on foot trying to get out to the Zoram Strand, was wrought with danger because of this tiger.  Thanks to you, this danger has abated.
24-complete.title: Shadumbra's Head

24-progress.name: Senani Thunderheart
24-progress.text: Greetings once again, $N!  Have you come to show me proof of your hunt?
24-progress.title: Shadumbra's Head

247-complete.name: Senani Thunderheart
247-complete.text:
$N, you have slain all three beasts that comprise the Ashenvale Hunt.  You have brought me adequate proof of their demise; there is no question of your strength and tenacity.  The blood of a hunter streaks through your veins, and you should be commended!

Please, accept this bauble as a sign of congratulations on your mighty deeds done in Ashenvale for the Horde today.  May your ancestors watch over you!
247-complete.title: The Hunt Completed

6441-complete.name: Pixel
6441-complete.text:
These are perfect, $N! Thanks for helping me out!

Oh, and this is for your time...
6441-complete.title: Satyr Horns

6441-progress.name: Pixel
6441-progress.text: I hope you can be quick about getting those horns, $N. I'm heading back to Ratchet soon!
6441-progress.title: Satyr Horns

6462-complete.name: Mitsuwa
6462-complete.text:
You found them!  Thank you!  Thank you, $N!  You do not know how great a thing you have done for me.

A $r without his charm is like an orc without his battle scars...

Worthless.
6462-complete.title: Troll Charm

6462-progress.name: Mitsuwa
6462-progress.text: Did you find the charms, $N?  Every moment the furbolgs possess those sacred items, my blood boils with rage!
6462-progress.title: Troll Charm

6621-accept.name: Karang Amakkar
6621-accept.text:
$N, another tribe of Furbolgs,  the Foulweald, live southeast of Astranaar.  They are not as many as the Thistlefur, but their ferocity poses a future threat.  With a show of force, we can remove that threat.

Take this banner, go to the Foulweald village and place it on their totem mound.  They will try to destroy the banner, but hold your ground until their chief, Murgut, appears to save face for the tribe.  Bring me the totem he carries.

Gather your allies, $N.  This is no task for a single $c.
6621-accept.title: King of the Foulweald
